placements.quote: The users of CESR in the 1980’s were CLEO at the south interaction point, CUSB in the north, CHESS

summary.plain: The CLEO particle detector at Cornell's CESR ring. A magnetic solenoid detector that was rebuilt and upgraded five times over thirty years with new trackers, calorimeters, particle-identification systems and silicon vertex detectors.
summary.technical: CLEO detector: five major upgrades (CLEO-1, CLEO-1.5, CLEO-2 with CsI calorimeter, CLEO-2.5 with silicon vertex detector, CLEO-3 with RICH, CLEO-c); described in 'The CLEO II detector', NIM A320 (1992) 66-113.

technology.quote: the CLEO detector underwent five major upgrades, each time incorporating new technologies in particle detection and identification
technology.value: Magnetic spectrometer detector with a drift-chamber tracker, a calorimeter, particle-identification systems and, from 1995, a silicon vertex detector; upgraded five times
